claims.location: comment[data file], assay name, comment[fraction identifier], comment[technical replicate] rows 1-36
claims.value: 1.raw..18.raw, members of 5148SQ_rawdata.zip; fraction = file number; technical replicate 1
claims.evidence: 5148SQ_rawdata.zip holds exactly 18 Thermo RAW members 1.raw..18.raw. No experimental design was deposited for this search (no mqpar.xml/summary.txt); the 18 RAWs share one acquisition method (D:\20150702_5148SQ\SILAC_GlobalQuant_40min_TOP20_30s) and one acquisition folder, and the protocol describes one mixed SILAC lysate fractionated by high-pH RP HPLC, so file number = fraction number is assumed (see limitations) The same member names (1.raw...) occur in both raw zips, so the two searches are written as two SDRF files (PXD004941-proteome, PXD004941-ubiquitylome); assay name is the build default (file stem). No comment[file uri] is given because the runs have no individual URL (they are archive members).

claims.location: comment[label], source name, characteristics[cell line], characteristics[treatment], factor value[cell line], factor value[treatment] rows 1-36
claims.value: SILAC light (rows 1-18) = PC9/GR, cultured with 3 uM gefitinib -> source PC9-GR_light_proteome; SILAC heavy (rows 19-36) = PC9 parental, no gefitinib (untreated) -> source PC9_heavy_proteome
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol and paper 2.1: 'PC9/GR cells were labeled with "light isotopic lysine" (12C-lysine), and PC9 cells were labeled with "heavy isotopic lysine" (13C-lysine) ... (the "light" labeled PC9/GR cells were treated with 3 uM gefitinib)'; paper 3.1: 'PC9 cells cultured in the medium without gefitinib, and PC9/GR cells cultured in the medium with gefitinib'; supplementary legend s006 Table S1: 'PC9/GR ... "L" in the table, PC9 ... "H"'. Data check against the paper's named proteins: proteome normalized H/L ALDH1A1 0.11 (paper/WB: up in PC9/GR), HMGA2 7.6 and CHEK2 7.3 (down in PC9/GR), ALOX5 0.22 and NUCB2 0.48 (up), EPHA2 3.4 and CNNM3 3.5 (down); 401 proteins with H/L<=0.5 and 148 with H/L>=2 vs paper 404 up / 148 down in PC9/GR. Ubiquitylome sites: ALOX5 and NUCB2 sites H/L 1.3-2.8 (paper: ubiquitylation down in PC9/GR), EPHA2 and CNNM3 sites H/L 0.28-0.54 (up in PC9/GR), ABCA12 four sites ~0.13 and one 2.2 (paper: two up, one down). Table S2 'Ratio (L:H)' = Intensity L/Intensity H (RBM47 2.07e9/8.26e8 = 1.89) with HMGA2 L:H 0.13 and CHEK2 0.14. Light = PC9/GR in both searches. Treatment value Gefitinib = NCIT:C1855 (dose 3 uM is stated here, not encodable in the bare value); PC9 rows 'untreated' (campaign rule 4).

One culture per condition: each line was expanded to ~5x10^8 cells in fifteen 150 cm2 flasks and harvested as one batch (paper 2.1); one heavy/light mixture was made (2.2); the deposits hold one SILAC experiment per search (mqpar.xml: one experiment, fractions 1-12). Each factor-value group (PC9/GR+gefitinib; PC9 untreated) therefore has one independent culture, numbered 1.

claims.value: rows 1-18: PC9/GR / not available / not available; rows 19-36: PC-9 / CVCL_B260 / PC-9
claims.evidence: PC-9 = Cellosaurus CVCL_B260 (ID PC-9, synonym PC9; human, lung adenocarcinoma; no other-species entry with that name in the search). PC9/GR was derived by this lab (paper 2.1: PC9 xenografts in nude mice treated with gefitinib 100 mg/kg for 2 months, survivors expanded in 3 uM gefitinib; STR shows common ancestry with PC9). Cellosaurus has no entry for this derivation: CVCL_E7RA 'PC-9/GR' (created 2025, ref PubMed 39080187, Wu et al., Clin Transl Oncol) is an independently derived line from another group, so neither its accession nor its name is used; the authors' name PC9/GR is kept in characteristics[cell line] (no CLO/BTO/EFO term - validator warning).

limitations: Partial-scope: none. All 30 deposited RAW runs (18 in 5148SQ_rawdata.zip, 12 in 5148SP_rawdata.zip) are annotated; no run is excluded and BLOCKED.md has no PXD004941 section.

RAW files are deposited only as members of two ZIP archives whose member names collide (1.raw.. in both). The deposit is therefore split into PXD004941-proteome.sdrf.tsv (5148SQ) and PXD004941-ubiquitylome.sdrf.tsv (5148SP): in one file parse_sdrf convert-openms fails with 'A SILAC channel occurs more than once in 1.raw'. comment[file uri] is omitted because the runs have no individual URL.

Fraction count discrepancy: paper 2.4 says the 80 high-pH RP fractions were 'combined into eight fractions', but 18 (proteome) and 12 (ubiquitylome, mqpar fractions 1-12) RAW files were deposited; paper 2.5 also says the Kub eluates were 'combined'. The deposited files and mqpar.xml are followed.

Single SILAC experiment per study arm: one culture per condition, no biological replicates and no label swap; the cell-line contrast is confounded with gefitinib exposure (PC9/GR kept in 3 uM gefitinib, PC9 without), as the paper itself states. Both are encoded as factor values.

PC9/GR has no Cellosaurus entry of its own (CVCL_E7RA 'PC-9/GR' is a different group's 2025 derivation), so cellosaurus accession/name are not available; donor-level values (age, sex, ancestry, disease, sites) are those of the parental PC-9 (CVCL_B260), supported by the paper's STR statement.

PRIDE structured fields are wrong for this deposit and were overridden: instruments 'LTQ Orbitrap' (RAW headers: Q Exactive Plus) and organismParts 'Smooth muscle cell of small intestine' (PC-9 is a lung adenocarcinoma line from a lymph-node metastasis).
characteristics[cell type] and characteristics[passage number] are not available in any source.
Review: REVIEW_PENDING_EXTERNAL - no independent review has been run on these files.

comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available for the 5148SQ search (no mqpar.xml/summary.txt; parameters.txt lacks it; the paper's 10 ppm conflicts with the companion search's deposited 5 ppm). Consequence: parse_sdrf convert-openms exits 1 ('Cannot read precursor mass tolerance: not available'), as for campaign precedents.
5148SQ fraction numbers are assumed from the file numbering (1..18): no experimental design for this search was deposited.

5148SQ SILAC label (Lys6) and the variable modifications are taken from the paper plus parameters.txt, because no mqpar.xml/summary.txt (labelMods) was deposited for this search; the GG variable modification stated in the paper's combined methods is not used because the search output has no GlyGly site table.
